verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform that ships SDKs, plugins and a dashboard, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection or any opt-out control. The cited items cover only payment features, SDK integration, status pages and llms.txt/OpenAPI probes, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
